scope: Native rebuilt source layouts vs prior native source previews; original content only.

pixel_diff.algorithm: Pixels are converted to straight-alpha 8-bit NRGBA. Exact mismatches compare all RGBA channels. RGB error is absolute per-channel difference; per-pixel thresholds use the maximum RGB delta. Difference RGB is abs(delta)*4 clamped to 255 (unchanged pixels black); overlay averages all four converted RGBA channels. This is a pixel comparison and does not certify visual fidelity.
